---
title: "Save, sync and stop"
---

::: {.callout-important}
## Always stop your Codespace when you finish
Closing the browser tab is not the same as stopping the Codespace.
:::

Before leaving:

1. Save all notebooks and files.
2. Commit your changes.
3. Sync them with GitHub.
4. Verify the repository on GitHub.
5. Stop the Codespace.

Your GitHub repository is the permanent copy of your work.
